From: Altman, Lana R. <Lana.R.Altman@espn.com>
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2015 10:25 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Cc: Moore, Ashoka; Guijarro, Robert; Fisher, Kevin M.
Subject: FENECH 12:30pm Sports Center Segment - QUESTIONS 
 
Anthony,
Here are your questions for the 12:30pm Sports Center segment. The anchor is Randy Scott.
Thank you so much!
1) ANTHONY, THE TIGERS SIT AT EXACTLY 500...44 WINS AND 44 LOSSES...
THEY ALSO SIT AT 3RD IN THE AL CENTRAL...
WHAT COULD THEY DO AT THE TRADE DEADLINE IF THEY HOPE TO GET INTO CONTENTION?
2) JUSTIN VERLANDER RETURNED ON JUNE 13TH FROM A TRICEP INJURY...
IT'S BEEN A BIT OF A ROUGH START FOR HIM SO FAR...
HOW IMPORTANT IS A GOOD VERLANDER TO THE TIGERS' SECOND HALF HOPES?
3) SPEAKING OF INJURIES, DETROIT LOST MIGUEL CABRERA ON JULY 3RD...
HE'S EXPECTED TO BE OUT AT LEAST A MONTH...
HOW MUCH DOES THIS HURT THE TIGERS IN THE SECOND HALF OF THE SEASON?
